title: Waterbike & Boat Adventures
specs: Located on the Erie Barge Canal, no operation allowed on Niagara River
Primary pontoon boat operator must have NY State Boaters Safety Course certification (card or phone image acceptable)
All ages welcome if able to hold paddle or reach pedals; sweet spot typically 6-8 years old
includes: Life jackets provided for all; required for ages 11 and under
Bluetooth compatible sound system on pontoon boat
blurb: Guests can rent kayaks, paddle boards, and waterbikes on a first come, first serve basis. A single pontoon boat is available for 3-hour rentals by reservation only. The location is under the Gateway Harbor Bridge in Tonawanda, NY, on the Erie Barge Canal.
extraNote: $50 credit card deposit required at pontoon boat reservation, refundable if canceled 48 hours prior · $500 day-of cash deposit required for pontoon boat, refundable upon return barring damages · Late arrivals billed from original start to original return time · Management may postpone or cancel due to inclement weather with appropriate refunds · 5% fee applied to credit card charges · Under the Gateway Harbor Bridge in Tonawanda, NY · Memorial Day Weekend through Labor Day Weekend, weather dependent
